text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One evening, while I'm walking<n>through the
shopping district with<n>Grass Wonder...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Look at that lively crowd. Is there an<n>event taking
place?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand-prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see... It's a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Which reminds me... Were you aware,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's said that raffles were originally<n>conceived by
the nobility long ago as<n>a way to entertain
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They would have people draw strips<n>of paper with
letters on them and give<n>out prizes like cloth and
string.

Aren't you well-informed! How about<n>giving it a
go?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, why not? I just happen to have<n>a raffle ticket
right here. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you wouldn't mind if I try<n>just once, would
you?
choice_data_list: Go get the grand-prize!
Go get the grand-prize!

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll do my best to not let you<n>down.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder firmly grasps the lever<n>with both
hands and gives the raffle<n>machine a spin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>tumbler's
opening...

Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!
You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What? R-really?

I'm overjoyed, truly, but I'm afraid I<n>don't have
the time for a vacation at<n>the moment.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you couldn't find the time somehow?
Are you sure you couldn't find the time somehow?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not right now, I'm afraid.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I suppose once things settle<n>down, I could use
this as an<n>opportunity to reflect on the path I'll<n>have
traveled thus far.
choice_data_list: So in other words, after the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That way, I'll be able to<n>ascertain my level of
satisfaction with<n>the path I've taken.

It would be the perfect time to take a<n>step back and
reflect on my progress.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would you come along with me too,<n>Trainer?
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me along?
Are you sure you want me along?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who has been with<n>me every step
of the way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Make it a promise, Trainer. It would<n>strengthen my
motivation.
choice_data_list: Okay. I'm looking forward to it.
Okay. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll commit myself to<n>training in
preparation for that day.

I take the hot spring ticket from her<n>with an
affirmative nod.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, that looks delicious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Add some grated Japanese radish<n>sauce and I'm
sure it'll taste<n>absolutely spectacular.
choice_data_list: Should we buy the sauce on the way home?
Should we buy the sauce on the way home?

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think I would rather buy the<n>radishes and
make the sauce myself.
So, could we visit the greengrocer<n>instead?
choice_data_list: Sure.
Sure.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The idea of making homemade sauce<n>sounds so
good that my stomach<n>starts grumbling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's almost dinnertime, after all.
Trainer, would you like to share it with<n>me?
choice_data_list: Is that okay with you?
Is that okay with you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ♪ Food is always more<n>enjoyable with
company.

I take Grass Wonder up on her offer<n>and eat some
of the deluxe carrot<n>hamburger steak with her.

We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Lucky indeed... This certainly is a lot<n>of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you like a few of<n>them? ♪
choice_data_list: Are you sure?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'll also give some to Spe<n>and El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And, since she does so much for me,<n>perhaps
Tazuna, too.
choice_data_list: You'll be giving away a lot.
You'll be giving away a lot.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes. But hoarding them all to<n>myself would
present a risk of<n>overeating.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sharing them is my best method of<n>self-control. ♪
choice_data_list: Brilliant, as always.
Brilliant, as always.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Competition will be fierce for the<n>foreseeable future,
so maintaining a<n>perfect condition is key.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't worry. I won't neglect<n>to keep a
portion for myself, either! ♪

Impressed by her self-discipline, I<n>return to the
academy with Grass<n>Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third-prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I set my hopes too high, it<n>seems.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then again, this might be just what I<n>needed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I forgot to purchase carrots for<n>tonight's salad at
the supermarket<n>earlier today, so the timing
couldn't<n>be better.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
True, true. You might've been wishing<n>for a carrot
the whole time, and you<n>just didn't know it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So, you mean... fate may have had a<n>hand in this,
too?
In that case, this could very well bemy grand-prize.
choice_data_list: That worked out nicely, Grass.
That worked out nicely, Grass.

text_block_list.text:
It really did. ♪ Tonight's salad is going<n>to taste that
much better.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder gains some hop in her<n>step as we
head back to the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is disappointing. I had hoped<n>for an actual
prize of some sort.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Winning raffles must be quite the rare<n>occurrence.
choice_data_list: Have you not played much before?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I haven't. I never had the opportunity<n>before
coming to Japan, you see.

Before I tried, I thought it would be<n>enough fun just
to spin the tumbler,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Losing stings a lot more than I<n>expected...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't get so down on yourself.<n>Better luck
next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If you say so...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's shoulders sink as<n>we head back.
